title: Wash tank fill timeout
shortDescription: Tank did not reach proper fill level.
fullDescription: Jackson WWS detected tank failed to fill within timeout. Check supply, fill valve, and sensor.

title: Tank heat fault
fullDescription: Heater timed out reaching setpoint. Scale or element failure.

title: Booster heat fault
shortDescription: Final rinse booster did not heat.
fullDescription: Booster element timed out. Scale or element failure.

title: Drain timeout
shortDescription: Tank did not drain in time.
fullDescription: Drain pump or valve failed to evacuate water.

faq.a: Confirm building drain not backed up.

title: Wash motor overload
fullDescription: Motor drew too much current. Check for jammed impeller.

fixSteps.title: Inspect pump
fixSteps.instruction: Tech opens pump and clears debris.

title: Chemical low
fullDescription: Float in chemical jug indicates empty container.

title: Control fault
fullDescription: Generic control fault. Power cycle, then service.
